record.question: The Human Resource Development Ministry conducted the first ever Indian Scholastic Assessment (IND-SAT) Test 2020 in India recently. Which of the following statements stands true? 1) IND-SAT is an exam for grant of scholarships and admissions to foreign students for studying in select Indian Universities. 2) The Exam is designed to gauge the scholastic capability of students applying to study in India 3) The IND-SAT scores will serve as a criterion to shortlist the meritorious students for the allocation of scholarships for under graduate as well as post graduate programmed under study in India.
record.explanation: All three IND-SAT statements are true.
